name: Duplicate customer identity
description: The same customer appears under slightly different identifying details in the CRM and communication system. Entity resolution should recognize them as the same customer when the available evidence is sufficiently strong.

primary_only.interpretation: Potential follow-up gap based on the CRM opportunity timeline.

cross_system.interpretation: The communication belongs to the same customer and can be safely used as additional context for the opportunity.

expected.recommendation: Use the resolved communication context and follow up with the opportunity owner.
